lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately four to five horizontal rows of high-luminance circular spots are visible on the lateral flank posterior to the branchial region, with the highest-intensity clusters located in the central-lateral section.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated intensity intersect with the horizontal rows of spots, forming a fragmented grid pattern most apparent in the mid-flank region.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A distinct horizontal ridge is visible along the upper third of the visible flank, defined by a sharp transition from high-luminance dorsal pixels to a lower-intensity shadow gradient immediately ventral to the ridge.

other_distinctive_markers: The right pectoral fin is prominently visible in the lower-left quadrant, exhibiting a high density of small circular spots that diminish in size toward the fin's distal margin.
